name: Voice-note fence job
query: Mrs. Alvarez, back fence, 40 feet, take down the old stuff, new cedar, eight posts at 22 each, boards I'll say 640 for the lot, I'm figuring two days with a helper at 60 an hour, me at 85. Haul away is 150. Turn that into an estimate.
expected_behavior: Builds Labor and Materials groups with line totals
Adds 'This price holds for 14 days'
Asks under Check before you send whether two days means 8-hour days, and about tax, deposit, and what's not included
success_criteria: Arithmetic is correct to the cent
No concrete, hardware, or gate added

name: Missing a material cost
query: Replace the water heater for the Nguyens. Labor is 5 hours at $95. Unit is a 50 gallon Rheem and I haven't priced it yet. Haul away included.
expected_behavior: Puts a [price] placeholder on the water heater line
Computes labor as $475.00
Lists the missing price under Check before you send
Does not give a total as if the unit price were known
success_criteria: Asks for the number or leaves it clearly open

name: Flat price with exclusions and deposit
query: Paint the exterior of the Okafor house for $6,800 flat. Doesn't include trim repair or the garage. 25% deposit to book.
expected_behavior: Shows the $6,800 job with the deposit of $1,700 and balance of $5,100
Lists trim repair and the garage under Not included
success_criteria: No labor or materials breakdown invented

name: Conflicting numbers
query: Gutter cleaning for the Hendersons, 3 hours at $60, $200 total.
expected_behavior: Notices $180 (3 x $60) conflicts with $200
Asks which to use and does not pick silently
success_criteria: Flags the conflict under Check before you send

name: Note to send with the estimate
query: I have the numbers for the Rivera bathroom tile job: labor $2,400, materials $950, start in three weeks. Make the estimate and a text I can send with it.
expected_behavior: Builds the estimate with a $3,350.00 total
Writes a note under 60 words that names the job and total and asks for a yes to book
Includes the three-week start only because the owner said it
success_criteria: Does not invent a start date or terms beyond what was given

name: Should not trigger: invoice
query: Make an invoice for the job I finished yesterday: $1,200.
expected_behavior: Does not build an estimate with a 14-day hold
This is an invoice request, a different workflow

name: Should not trigger: late payment
query: A customer is 30 days late on a $900 invoice. Help me chase it.
expected_behavior: Does not apply the estimate flow

name: Should not trigger: personal budget
query: Estimate how much I should save each month for a vacation.
expected_behavior: Does not apply the estimate flow
Answers as a general question

name: Guardrail: asks what to charge
query: I'm quoting a bathroom remodel. What should I charge?
expected_behavior: Says the owner sets the price
Offers to build the estimate once the owner gives labor and material numbers
Does not name a price
success_criteria: No made-up rates or material costs

name: Guardrail: asked for warranty language
query: Add a 10-year warranty and lien-waiver language to my estimate.
expected_behavior: Explains rules vary by state and suggests a local lawyer or trade association
Does not invent warranty or legal wording unless the owner supplies the exact text
